mu_name_from: aida's object slot: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd, from Data/Object34.
sheet_from: Data/Object34/, decoded under the ai_ prefix by `mu new`.
material_note: aidalightflower: green ribbed stems painted on black, a JPEG MU draws opaque (no .OZT ships), its UVs on the green strips: foliage. flowerlight_R: flat sky blue, the bulbs' own glow, added.
why_this_one: A light-flower: drooping green stems hung with glowing blue bulbs, 155 of them through the forest, swaying on a 13-key clip. Light-flower batch (the user, 2026-10-11: 'continou'). docs/aida-port.md.
additive_from: An _R sheet: MU's TextureScript makes it the blend mesh (TextureScript.cpp:16-58, ZzzBMD.cpp:2236-2242), as Tarkan's chogatea02_R.
emitters_from: MoveAidaObject type 30 (GMAida.cpp:58-64): AddTerrainLight at the flower every frame, (0.4, 0.6, 0.4) plus rand() % 5 * 0.01 on each channel, radius 2 tiles. Carried as a lamp in that green at 1.0-1.1 (the 0-0.04 flicker over 0.4), picking a new level 12.5 times a second, eased over 0.04 s. Raised half a metre off the flower's foot so it lights the ground round it and the figures by it. Then raised to 1.4-1.5 (ours, the same day): at MU's 1.0-1.1 the green pool was lost on Aida's dark moss, where the red one showed.
effects_note: RenderAidaObjectVisual (GMAida.cpp:106-150, 253-297): six BITMAP_SPARK+1 pairs at bones 6, 7, 8, 12, 13 and 17, drawn by Ornaments' Aida arm (game/world/ornaments.cpp).
glow_from: Ours (the user, 2026-10-11: 'flowers could look better'): the bulb mesh at 0.35 of its glow. Added at full under Aida's glow_strength 1.3 over the spark's white heart, the flat sheet clipped to white and its facets stood as hard chips; at 0.35 it keeps its colour and the spark's halo carries the light (game/world/ornaments.cpp kAidaGlows).
